Transparent background everywhere outside the letters/face. No opaque white backdrop, no cast shadow background or checkerboard baked in. Tight horizontal composition with small clean transparent margins; entire logo visible, no clipping. Change only the wordmark, no favicon, no additional elements or taglines.

coverSet.assignment: Shuffle unique variants at deal time and persist the remaining order internally. Public team racks preview only the next variant without a board position; an accepted reveal receives that cover. Project per-card coverVariant only after reveal.
coverSet.format: Native generated PNGs, copied without pixel processing.
coverSet.validation: No verification, independent review or tests, per direct user instruction.
coverSet.replacementPolicy: One current unversioned cover set; replace files in place without retaining older editions. Characters use their own familiar clothing or natural fur. Pepe is blue; the assassin is the original Wojak in his black hoodie.
